item.title: Trump welcomes China's Xi for state dinner at White House
item.description: President Trump hosted Chinese President Xi Jinping for a state dinner on Thursday, as the world's two most powerful countries extend a tariff truce.

item.title: Forecasters warn Hurricane Nolo may bring catastrophic flooding to Hawaii
item.description: Forecasters say Nolo could strengthen into a major hurricane by the weekend as it approaches Hawaii's Big Island.

item.title: Dolly Parton's final vocal recording to feature on U2's new album Carnaval de Luz
item.description: Dolly Parton's last recording of her career will be included on U2's upcoming album.

item.title: FDA nominee emphasizes vaccine safety at confirmation hearing
item.description: Dr. Heidi Overton testified before a Senate committee on Thursday at her confirmation hearing for FDA commissioner.
